purpose: Stress V3 in a true streaming prefix regime where endpoint/log-e queries are interleaved with appends, with every append required to invalidate all cached root brackets.
cache_contract_checks: Each append was followed by a direct assertion that every V3 component root cache was empty before any new query.
Repeated log_e queries at an identical m under an unchanged envelope produced exact repeated values and zero additional root-stat calls.
No stale cached bracket survived an append in either stress family.
V3's existing fail-closed residual check raised no ArithmeticError in the tested streams.
conclusion: The streaming-prefix regression passed in the tested numerical regimes. V3 retained V2 endpoint decisions with sub-2e-12 endpoint disagreement while preserving mandatory append invalidation and reducing root-stat work by about 92.5% to 93.9% in these local tests.
scope_guards: This validates the V3 computational path against V2; it does not independently prove the underlying e-process derivation.
Stats-call reductions are local prototype measurements, not deployment latency claims.
The random/edge regimes are finite tests and do not prove absence of all floating-point edge cases.
